puzzles.logic: Compare a solid scalloped plaque and a hollow dotted plaque; keeper demonstrates echoes, then the player selects the matching visible outline with A.
puzzles.hint: A hollow shell gives a broken outline. Look at its edge, not its color.
puzzles.reset: Either plaque can be inspected repeatedly; choosing wrong never consumes anything.

puzzles.logic: A transparent buoyancy diagram and hand lever raise one empty shelf while its paired shell lowers. Step off the shelf and use the lever again to show the return route.
puzzles.hint: One rises when the other settles. The handle works from this landing.
puzzles.reset: Lever is always on stable ground; A reverses either state.

puzzles.logic: Walk a short loop around the low shelf to its visible other landing; no ability or gear is needed. Talk to the shellwright on return for Bobclam.
puzzles.hint: The pale stepping shells stay in place when the shelf moves.
puzzles.reset: No persistent moving state; both fixed landings remain reachable.

puzzles.logic: Echo reveals a permanent dotted shoreline on one of two translucent map leaves. Toggle a marked ballast shelf to overlay the broken coastline, then manually rotate the other leaf90 degrees until the two positive and negative outlines agree.
puzzles.hint: The torn edge fits the empty space in the other map. You can study both as long as you need.
puzzles.reset: Pedestal at[28,128] restores leaf rotations and shelf. Exit at[120,146] never closes.

puzzles.logic: Two linked lifts have different footprints. Choose the wide shelf as a bridge, walk its fixed side loop and lower the narrow shelf into a drawn recess. Read the procession sketch from the resulting high landing; no object is carried.
puzzles.hint: The long shelf can meet both landings. Its partner belongs in the narrow outline.
puzzles.reset: Pedestals[40,276] and[424,76] reach the same safe canonical arrangement; no hero may be inside a changed solid.

puzzles.logic: Echo traces sound around two curved baffles. Move the baffles manually until their unlit sound-shadow overlaps the missing footstep motif. The answer is the quiet negative space, never a particular audio frequency.
puzzles.hint: The drawing shows where no note returns. Trace the quiet gap.
puzzles.reset: Pedestal[24,132] restores baffles; all states retain an outer walking ring >=24px.

puzzles.logic: Two memory leaves give complementary versions of a procession. Echo reveals the guardian sculpture response; shift its marked ballast to open a safe side alcove, then bait its telegraphed sweep from either side and use the starter sword on the visible exposed joint. Three successful openings settle the guardian; no timer or damage race.
puzzles.hint: Its gaze follows the open page. The alcove holds still when the crest sweeps.
puzzles.reset: Defeat/death or RESET returns to entrance with guardian full health, no loss of completed prior-room records. Exit remains available.
